data: Does the hit ratio for LR generally decrease as the iteration number increases?

The question asks whether the hit ratio for LR generally decreases as the iteration number increases. To analyze this, I will look at the trend of the LR line across both graphs.

1. In the first graph (# of seed = 1), the LR line starts at approximately 0.15 and shows a general downward trend until around iteration 10, where it stabilizes near 0.1. After iteration 10, there is some fluctuation but no significant increase or decrease.

2. In the second graph (# of seed = 3), the LR line starts at approximately 0.2 and shows a more pronounced downward trend until around iteration 10, where it stabilizes near 0.1. Similar to the first graph, there is some fluctuation after iteration 10 but no significant increase or decrease.

From these observations, it appears that the hit ratio for LR generally decreases as the iteration number increases, although there is some fluctuation in later iterations.
